# crosswork_data_retention_device_performance (Data Source)

This data source can read the data retention of the device performance data.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "crosswork_data_retention_device_performance" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object
- `rows` (Attributes Map) Retention periods by policy type, for example `CEPM_INTERFACE`, in hours. A policy type that is not listed keeps its periods (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rows))

<a id="nestedatt--rows"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rows`

Read-Only:

- `daily_hours` (Number) Hours that daily data is kept, 336 to 8760, or 0 for a policy type without aggregation
- `hourly_hours` (Number) Hours that hourly data is kept, 72 to 720, or 0 for a policy type without aggregation
- `raw_hours` (Number) Hours that raw data is kept
- `weekly_hours` (Number) Hours that weekly data is kept, 336 to 17472, or 0 for a policy type without aggregation
